decision_scope: The named fields on the exact retained 2026-09 current-month archive only; not a universal RRC parser and not source activation.
encoding: ASCII for mapped type-01/type-02 fields; CRLF-delimited fixed records
span_convention: observed_span is zero-based [start,end); manual_pos is official 1-based start position

layout_rules.type_02: for mapped DAPERMIT payload fields, observed start = manual_pos - 3 because the observed file contains the leading record id only; the manual layout lists record ids at POS 1 and POS 3
layout_rules.unknown_rows: 35 lines begin byte 0x85; retain/quarantine without decoding or assigning meaning

fields.name: record_type
fields.official_manual: Record ID occupies the first two bytes; printed manual pages I.1 and II.2/II.18
fields.handling: ASCII bytes; classify only exact published IDs

fields.name: status_number / permit_number
fields.meaning: Seven-digit W-1 status number; for the modern records in this file, it becomes the permit number on approval. The manual notes older legacy exceptions.
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII digits; retain as text to preserve leading zeroes

fields.name: sequence
fields.meaning: Application/permit filing revision. The manual defines 99 as original and each amendment as the prior sequence minus one.
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII digits; not a date or chronological timestamp

fields.name: reported_county_code
fields.meaning: County reported by the operator on the W-1 application.

fields.name: approved_county_code
fields.meaning: County approved by RRC for the drilling operation.
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII digits; retain as text; do not force equal to reported_county_code

fields.name: reported_lease_name
fields.meaning: Lease name as reported by operator on W-1.
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII; source space-padded; display trimming must not overwrite raw evidence

fields.name: approved_lease_name
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII; source space-padded; display trimming must not overwrite raw evidence

fields.name: well_number
fields.meaning: Well number reported by operator on W-1.
fields.encoding_and_zero: ASCII; source space-padded; display trimming must not overwrite raw evidence

fields.name: application_status
fields.meaning: A means approved; P pending; other manual codes include withdrawn, dismissed, denied, closed, and other.

fields.name: root_permit_number
fields.meaning: Permit number assigned when W-1 is approved.
fields.observed_crosscheck: equals root status number and adjacent type-02 permit number in all 884 pairs

fields.name: root_permit_issued_date
fields.observed_crosscheck: equals adjacent type-02 permit_issued_date in all 884 pairs

fields.name: application_received_date
fields.meaning: Date W-1 application received in Austin.
fields.observed_crosscheck: root and permit values equal and form valid calendar dates in all 884 pairs

fields.name: permit_issued_date
fields.observed_crosscheck: valid calendar date and equals root permit issue date in all 884 pairs

fields.name: permit_amended_date
fields.zero_handling: 00000000 is preserved as the source zero representation; no event-date inference is made
fields.observed_snapshot: 237 nonzero valid dates; all sequence 98/97/96 rows have a nonzero date, and all sequence 99 rows are zero

fields.name: permit_extended_date
fields.zero_handling: 00000000 is preserved; 0 nonzero values in this snapshot

fields.name: permit_spud_date
fields.zero_handling: 00000000 is preserved as source data; no spud event/date is asserted for zero rows

fields.name: api8
fields.meaning: Manual describes an eight-digit API wellbore identifier with a three-digit county prefix and five-digit unique number.
fields.observed_crosscheck: all 884 values are eight digits and their first three bytes equal approved_county_code
fields.identity_limit: 868 distinct values among 884 permit revisions; API is not a permit-revision key. Three repeat groups appear under different permit numbers; relationship is UNKNOWN and no join is inferred.

manual_conflicts_and_unknowns: The type-02 manual layout lists record IDs at POS 1 and POS 3, whereas each observed daily type-02 segment has one leading 02 followed immediately by the seven-digit permit/status number. Applying the direct manual span would read the wrong key and push the manual API span beyond the observed 510-byte record. For the named type-02 fields only, the observed layout is consistently manual POS minus two 1-based positions (zero-based start = POS - 3), verified by 884 paired keys, date matches, API/county crosschecks, and all ten prior sample identities. This profile is tied to the retained file SHA, not assumed for future RRC versions.

The type-01 manual defines a 510-byte record via filler starting at POS 187, while this daily archive's type-01 records are 212 bytes. Mapped root fields through POS 120 fit and cross-check; omitted root tail fields are UNKNOWN and excluded.

The manual lists RRC-TAPE-FILLER at POS 503 overlapping API-NUMBER at POS 505 on printed page II.17. The filler is unmapped/UNKNOWN and excluded; the observed API span is at the final eight bytes and passes the stated county-prefix crosscheck.
35 physical lines begin with byte 0x85. Their semantics are UNKNOWN. The validator records count/prefix/lengths only and does not decode them.
All mapped zero-valued dates are retained as literal source strings. Zero is not converted into an asserted negative event.
next_action: A separately reviewed adapter packet may use only this hash-pinned type-01/type-02 profile, key permit history by status/permit number plus sequence, preserve raw evidence and zero dates, and quarantine/count unknown rows without interpretation. No API-only permit join, lifecycle inference, or source activation is authorized here.
